tier3.describes: advanced handling preferences, stratified by deterministic index arithmetic (no randomness)

notEnumerated: The full Cartesian product of preferences x weapons x distances x modes x priorities x scopes is ~1.7e9 evaluations and is not run. Tier 3 covers every preference combination against every class and the whole distance range instead.
Attachment combinations are not enumerated here; scripts/audit-optimizer-torture.mjs does that against the optimizer directly.
classChoice and context selectors are not swept: they filter which weapons are offered, and cannot change any weapon's computed combat values.
